title: Puffco Peak Pro Glass 2.0
description:
The Peak Pro Glass 2.0 is beauty and performance combined. Dual hand-blown borosilicate glass chambers showcase an elegant spiral design within. Five laser cut perc slots deliver improved airflow and filtration. It can be easily detached and reattached from the base to make cleaning and swapping simple.

Product Features:
– 100% borosilicate glass
– Compatible with Peak Pro and Peak

What’s Included:
1 x Peak Pro Glass 2.0

Compatible with New Peak Pro and Peak Pro
